caption: Titlis, Engelberg
composition: Engelberg valley looking south to the Titlis summit and glacier · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the Engelberg valley, Titlis closes the south as a high rock summit carrying a small glacier. The monastery town and late-September meadows sit in the foreground, still free of winter snow, while ice stays on the high face and no cable car is the subject. The Open-Meteo valley model is fully overcast, so cloud sits on the summit while the ice stays readable, and the temperature is the valley cell rather than a glacier thermometer.
